Thanks, Nora. Let me lay out the options for track 7, 'Night Transit.'

First option: We could renegotiate or amend the license with the rights holder of the sampled recording to expand coverage to physical products and all territories worldwide. That would let us keep the draft package as-is for track 7. I'd need to reach out to the licensor, and I can't guarantee they'll agree or on what timeline.

Second option: We could structure the release to respect the current license scope — meaning track 7 would be included only in the digital release in the United States and Canada, and excluded from physical products and from digital distribution in all other territories. That might mean a different track listing for physical versus digital, or for US/Canada versus the rest of the world.

Third option: We could replace the sampled recording in track 7 with an alternative that doesn't carry the same territorial and format restrictions, if one is available and creatively acceptable.

I'd also note that I still need to enter this restriction in the release tracker regardless of which option we pursue, so that it's properly documented. I can do that as soon as we have direction on how to proceed.

I can't advise on which option is best from a creative or commercial standpoint — that's for you and the team to weigh — but from a rights perspective, any of these three paths could work. What's your preference?
